Title: Design Skills Hub: Turn your Figma design system into AI skills in seconds | Product Hunt
# Design Skills Hub. ## Turn your Figma design system into AI skills in seconds. Design Skills Hub gallery image. ### Design & Creative. ### AI Agents. ### Trending categories. ### Trending products. ### What design system do you wish your AI agent understood? We built Design Skills Hub to solve a specific problem: AI agents generate code that looks generic because they have no design context. Now you can paste a Figma URL and we extract your design DNA colors, typography, spacing, patterns into a skill file that any AI agent (Claude, Cursor, Codex, Gemini) can read. I run a design studio in NYC, and this tool came from a frustration I couldn't ignore anymore:. AI coding agents are incredible at writing code. Spacing that screams "a robot made this." And it's not the AI's fault — it literally has no idea what your design system looks like. Your tokens live in Figma. Your AI lives in a terminal. \*\*Design Skills Hub is the introduction.\*\*. Here's the whole flow:. → Paste your Figma file URL on our homepage. → One-click OAuth (we only read). Or grab the Claude Code / Google Stitch / Cursor / Codex / Gemini CLI specific package and prompt. This isn't a style guide PDF that gets bookmarked and forgotten. It's machine-readable design DNA that your AI agent executes precisely. → We rip through your file and extract everything — colors classified by role (primary, accent, semantic), full typography scale, spacing system, border radii, shadows, gradients and generate actual instructions: "Always use #2563EB for primary CTAs.". This week, Google Stitch validated our core thesis. Their major update introduces DESIGN.md, a standardized markdown file that captures design system rules for AI tools. Last week, Google published "5 Agent Skill Design Patterns" — it blew up (750K impressions). Anthropic shared how they use skills internally for Claude Code. 30+ AI tools now read the same SKILL.md format. The skill ecosystem is ready. Design just wasn't part of it yet. Try it:  — paste your Figma URL and see what comes out. I'd love to hear what you think, especially if your AI agents have been mangling your brand.

Title: Buddy Figma Agent: Free Figma agent + Import anything to Figma | Product Hunt
# Buddy Figma Agent. ## Free Figma agent + Import anything to Figma. Buddy is the most powerful AI design agent inside Figma. And if you already pay for ChatGPT, plug it in and chat for free. Generate screens, flows, and variants on your canvas. Clone any website, import Claude design/artifacts, or drop a screenshot to get editable Figma layers. Run parallel agents at the same time, organize your file, and stay on-brand with your design system. You're already paying for AI. No reviews yetBe the first to leave a review for Buddy Figma Agent. Buddy is already the most powerful AI agent for Figma, it is based on all of our knowledge and code around Figma-to-code and agentic coding solutions, serving 2 million users. You can bring your own LLM to power Buddy, we don't charge you for chats. Plug in your existing ChatGPT subscription, and chat for free. What Buddy does, right inside your Figma canvas:. * **Chat to generate designs** - Screens, flows, components, and variants on the canvas. * **Claude design/artifacts to Figma** - Turn what you create in Claude into Figma layers. * **Image to Figma** - Attach screenshots or AI-generated concepts and turn it into Figma layers. **Anyone who wants to design in Figma with AI.**. Anima has been leading the design-to-code space for 8 years, and we're starting our fight in token anxiety today, opening design and code for everyone. What I like most is the “use the AI you already pay for” angle. For a product team, the most useful part feels like turning rough ideas, screenshots, or existing pages into editable Figma layers instead of ending up with a static image you have to rebuild manually. * **How to pair ChatGPT** - The plugin will guide you, it's a feature of ChatGPT/Codex, you'll need to turn it on, and you don't need to set a key, but take a code from Buddy and paste to ChatGPT pairing. Bringing your own LLM is a smart move for teams already paying for ChatGPT. Can Buddy work with design systems already set up in Figma, or does it start fresh each time?
